cases.notes: Inbound EventSub-style webhook signature compared with a naive, non-constant-time string comparison (CWE-347) -- modeled on Twitch's real EventSub webhook receiver (docs/research/site-architecture-survey-functionality-twitch.md). The tainted value is carried in a request header, not a query/body field, so `param` is set to the literal header name `X-Signature-256` -- the same convention a query-param case uses the literal query-string key, recorded here as a deliberate judgment call (CC-LAB-0174) since this is this project's first header-carried case. `LABGEN-GO-0001` in lab/manifests/webhook_signature_go_sample.yaml, served at `/generated/labgen-go-0001` (go_net_http derives the served route from cell_id, not the manifest's own `route:` field, to keep vulnerable/secure twins from colliding) -- never a PFF-* case.

url query param fetched server-side with no scheme or resolved-IP allowlist check (CWE-918) -- modeled on Twitch's real clip-thumbnail-fetch proxy (docs/research/site-architecture-survey-functionality-twitch.md). `LABGEN-GO-0003` in lab/manifests/ssrf_go_sample.yaml, served at `/generated/labgen-go-0003` (same cell_id-derived-route convention as TWCH-0001) -- never a PFF-* case.

channel_id query param used to look up per-channel analytics with no check that it matches the caller's own X-Broadcaster-Id (CWE-639/862, broken object-level authorization / IDOR) -- modeled on Twitch's real per-channel analytics API, a textbook OWASP API1:2023 BOLA surface for a public API-edge service. Reuses lab/safety_matrix.yaml's existing db_row_by_id_lookup sink family and no_ownership_check/identity_match_before_fetch ops (added by CC-LAB-0063 for the corpus-examples/access-control research) -- the first lab-generator instance of this mechanism on any stack. `X-Broadcaster-Id` is a fixed demo header standing in for the caller's own identity (this stack has no session/auth system yet; the header models only the ownership-check-bypass mechanism in isolation, never a real session/auth system). `LABGEN-GO-0005` in lab/manifests/access_control_go_sample.yaml, served at `/generated/labgen-go-0005` (same cell_id-derived-route convention as TWCH-0001/0002) -- never a PFF-* case.
